name: optimum-benchmark-multi-slurm
description: Benchmark suite for measuring multi-node/model performance using Hugging Face Optimum on Slurm-managed clusters. It provides workloads and scripts to evaluate throughput, latency, and scaling behavior across multi-GPU/multi-node Slurm setups. Intended for infrastructure and ML Ops benchmarking rather than model accuracy research.
reputation: Niche infrastructure benchmark maintained by CAIR-M3LLM; mainly used by ML systems and MLOps engineers, limited broad adoption.
